senses.gloss: to be clean, pure; to be cleared, acquitted, cleansed from sin.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 12:7">Targ. Lev. XII, 7</cite> <he>ותִדְכֵּי</he> O. ed. Berl. (ed. <he>ותַ׳</he> incorr., Y. <he>ותִדְכֵי</he>). Ib. XVI, 30 <he>תִּדְכּוֹן</he> O. (Y. <he>תֵּידְכוּן</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 24:13">Targ. Ezek. XXIV, 13</cite> <he>תִדְכִּין</he> (Nun emphat.; ed. Lag. <he>תדכן</he>); a. fr.
<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 23:2">Targ. O. Deut. XXIII, 2</cite> sq.—
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ruth 2:10">Targ. Ruth II, 10</cite>.
Lev. R. s. 34 [read:] זכי בי או דכי בי, v. זְכֵי.—Part. דָּכֵי, f. דַּכְיָא.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 65:5">Targ. Is. LXV, 5</cite> <he>דְּכֵינָא וכ׳</he> I am purer than &c., v. <cite ref="D00773"><he>דְּכֵי</he></cite>. [<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 6:11">Targ. Prov. VI, 11</cite>, v. <cite ref="D01095"><he>דְּרַךְ</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: to clear, purify; to restore to levitical cleanness, to cleanse.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 24:13">Targ. Ezek. XXIV, 13</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 16:30">Targ. Lev. XVI, 30</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 79:6">Gen. R. s. 79</cite> <he>לית אנן מְדַכָּן יתה וכ׳</he> should we not restore it (Tiberias) to levitical cleanness from the slain (buried there)?; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 133:27">Yalk. ib. 133</cite> <he>מְדַכְּיָין</he>. Gen. R. l. c. [read:] <he>צרוכין אנו מְדַכְּיָהּ לטבריא</he> we must cleanse Tiberias (Pesik. B’shall. p. 89ᵇ <he>למזכייה</he>); <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:8:1">Koh. R. to X, 8</cite>.—
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:8:1">Ib.</cite> <he>דדַכְּיֵיה</he> which he had declared clean. Y. Shebi. IX, 38ᵈ <he>מְדַכֵּי טיבריא</he>.—
<cite ref="Niddah 6b:8">Nidd. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>מְדַכָּן וכ׳</he> observe the same levitical cleanness as required for Temple offerings, v. <cite ref="H00113"><he>חַבְרָא</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to became clean, be cleansed (from sin), be purified.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 11:4">Targ. II Sam. XI, 4</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 14:4">Targ. Lev. XIV, 4</cite> <he>לִדְמִדַּכֵּי</he> ed. Berl. (Var. <he>לַמִּידַּכֵּי</he>; Y. <he>לִדְמִדְכֵּי</he>); ib. 7; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be cleared away, be removed, be gone.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 2b:2">Ber. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>אִדַּכֵּי יומא</he> the day is past; v. <cite ref="I00102"><he>טְהֵר</he></cite>.
